{{Quote|Sorry. Not interested in wk'ou melons today, thanks.|Wedge Antilles to the seller|<ref name="SpecPast" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''member''' of the [[Morish]] species ran a produce table at a busy marketplace on the<ref name="SpecPast" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Morishim]]<ref name="SpecPast" /> as of [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].<ref name="EssReaCom">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> In that year, the seller tried to interest [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|general]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] in purchasing a [[wk'ou melon]]. Mistaking his [[Limb/Legends|palms]]-out gesture of refusal for haggling and believing that he was trying to negotiate a better price for the item, the seller followed Antilles doggedly, speaking loudly in [[Morish language|her language]], until Antilles was able to make an escape through the local crowds. Antilles' comrade [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] witnessed the exchange and subsequently explained the meaning of the [[Sign language/Legends|hand signs]] Antilles had used, to the latter's exasperation.<ref name="SpecPast" />

==Behind the scenes==
The wk'ou seller first appeared in the novel ''[[Specter of the Past]]'', which was written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and released in [[1997]].<ref name="SpecPast" />
